title: system/kit.json
description: The manifest of a memory-kit release: its version, what it needs and the hash of every kit-owned file (docs/maintenance.md, "Upgrading the kit"). node system/tools/release.mjs writes it; upgrade and doctor read it. A hash is the sha256 of the text without a BOM, with LF line ends and in NFC (a binary file as it is). kit.json and kit-history.json themselves are not listed. #/$defs/history describes system/kit-history.json.

version.description: Version of this release, the same as system/VERSION.

data_version.description: The memory.json "version" (data layout) this release reads and writes.

api_version.description: Version of the public JS API (system/api.mjs).

node.description: Oldest Node.js version the release runs on.

upgrade_from.description: Oldest installed version this release can upgrade.

source.description: Where upgrade fetches new versions by default: a git URL or a folder.

files.description: Every kit-owned file of the release by its repository-relative path.

relPath.description: A repository-relative POSIX path: forward slashes, no leading or trailing slash, no empty, . or .. segments.

group.description: Ownership group; it decides what upgrade does with the file.

history.title: system/kit-history.json
history.description: Every shipped hash of every kit-owned file, by release: { "<version>": { "<path>": "<sha256>" } }. upgrade treats a file of the vault as unmodified when its hash is one of them.
